name: ECWA World Championship
epitaph: Held by Tommy Van Dam as of the fed's own September 1997 launch, a reign corroborated the same month by a third-party dream-match card staging him beating SPWA's own World Champion. Two other names are billed elsewhere in the held record as former holders -- Kevin Kage, before moving on to run RCW, and "Madness" Kaine Merson, later a manager in another fed's storyline -- but no document recovered here sequences either against Van Dam's own reign.

name: ECWA East Coast Championship
epitaph: Held by "The Franchise" Andru Edwards as of the fed's own September 1997 launch.

name: ECWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced as vacant and due to be decided on the fed's own weekly card the same week its founding post was made; no result survives in this collection's own 1997 holdings.
notes: ECWA's own founding post, 3 September 1997: "the tag team titles will be decided this weekend on SMASH!"
